verdict.rationale: Auth0's docs list passkeys, WebAuthn biometrics, and email/SMS passwordless as supported login methods alongside username/password and social. They also describe letting users log in with one-time codes delivered by email or SMS, and passkeys synced across devices. Separately, WebAuthn (security keys and device biometrics) is documented as an MFA factor. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of magic-link support, in-depth setup docs showing these as configurable primary connections, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
